## Security and trust checklist
- [ ] No passwords, tokens, private keys, personal data, or confidential evidence are committed.
- [ ] New dependencies, GitHub Actions, models, datasets, and external tools have reviewed provenance, licence, maintainer, and update path.
- [ ] GitHub Actions use full commit-SHA pins; workflow token permissions are least-privilege.
- [ ] Inputs and imported files are validated; untrusted content cannot override system instructions or safety controls.
- [ ] No hidden telemetry, remote upload, undocumented network call, or unapproved external service is introduced.
- [ ] Tests, security checks, and relevant failure cases were run; results are linked below.
- [ ] AI outputs remain advisory/proposal-only; deterministic safety controls and human approval remain in control of consequential actions.
- [ ] Rollback/recovery path and evidence location are identified.
- [ ] No paid API, subscription, metered cloud, or unexpected billing exposure is introduced.
